unresolvedPublicationFindings.title: Russian B1 has no current schema and runtime path for the reviewed full gender alternatives
unresolvedPublicationFindings.evidence: The actual shared B1 schema only permits English/Spanish/French/Italian/Portuguese and strict lesson objects omit genderAlternatives. The current Russian runtime contains 100 A1 and 100 A2 lessons and zero B1 lessons. No genderAlternatives consumer is present in frontend/src or frontend/scripts. normalizeGuidedAnswer performs NFC, whitespace and case normalization, not ё→е folding. Thus the seven reviewed complete male alternatives and explicit е-spellings are not yet implemented acceptance evidence.
unresolvedPublicationFindings.impact: Publishing through the current path would either reject the draft shape or omit the reviewed alternative input. A correct learner may be penalized for a male form or normal е spelling.
unresolvedPublicationFindings.requiredAction: Implement and independently review a true Russian B1 extension with Russian/ru-RU identity and strict optional lesson.genderAlternatives keys '1'/'3' only. Map complete reviewed strings plus explicit е folds to the actual typed/spoken surfaces, preserving canonical target text; never generate suffix replacements or mutate frozen A1/A2. Confirm the B1 0.65/15-second scaffold and voice roster in the eventual integrated path.
unresolvedPublicationFindings.verification: Re-run the exact final Russian sources through the Russian gate and inspect real rendered Russian B1 fixtures and acceptance behavior. The later scratch gate under construction is outside this review.

lessonCoverage.semanticAudit: Imperfective duration is coherent across flying, bus travel, walking and admiring; осматривали in the complication is now natural. Recall uses finite-form contrasts rather than a plausible alternative journey.
The Sunday timing is now consistent. Both learner turns use the established plural narrator; the рынок/рынка/рынке/рынком case contrast fixes the recall choice.
The parcel is already home, so the completed post-office story and the follow-up agree. ждали/искали are safe plural subjects; no new speaker gender form.

lessonCoverage.semanticAudit: The solo concert story remains solo through the night-bus closing. The cloze's пришёл/довёз agree with автобус; its new е variants must be regenerated. Base timing precision remains RU-B1-PUB-04.

genderAlternatives.1: Я случайно встретил преподавателя в библиотеке, когда искал книгу по истории.

lessonCoverage.semanticAudit: The chance encounter leads naturally to ongoing study with the teacher; closing мы includes the previously named teacher, so it is not an unexplained narrator switch. A2 future is explicitly licensed.
Мне кажется introduces an opinion; the morning difficulty receives a causal explanation. All learner forms are gender-free and impersonal cloze cues choose the correct adverbs.
The film opinion and understandable, engaging ending are coherent. The finite/adjectival contrasts in recall and impersonal cloze have one cued canonical answer.
The classes' value is justified by speaking practice, and the price increase leads to a clear cost/value concession. The interlocutor's ли is recognition-only, not new learner production.
Хотя introduces a real cold-versus-enjoyment concession; the scarf closing addresses the wind. Cloze cues are sound. Valid build reordering remains RU-B1-PUB-03.
The small flat is contrasted with its location; noise is contrasted with easy commuting. New recall центре is semantically fixed by the opening and the remembered first turn.
Coffee softness and aroma strength are distinct properties; the price complication is answered by a preference despite cheaper cost. The reviewed приятнее is a cued comparative.
An otherwise convenient freezing app leads to lost notes; saving even short notes and writing them again continues the problem. The edited писать всё заново is idiomatic.
The restaurant's price/ingredient tradeoff leads to a concrete fish-soup recommendation, sharing a large portion. The edited съесть is natural and the cloze reproduces it.
Пожалуй softens ending the meeting; fatigue and the remaining question lead to dealing with it tomorrow. Gender-free impersonal comparisons are staged.
Наоборот corrects the premise about remote work; concentration at home and harder communication are real opposing considerations. The balanced closing and two comparatives are coherent.

mechanicalChecks.method: Read-only Python assertions over bound JSON and actual frozen Russian source trophy literals. No author generator/validator was executed and no shared Latin-language validator was portrayed as Russian validation.
checked: Russian/ru-RU/B1/German identity; 10 lessons per path; complete de/en objects
Chunks join first learner turn exactly; canonical chips plus distractors distinct
Two cloze blanks per lesson; exact closing reconstruction; four distinct ё-folded choices with canonical once; form cue present iff required
Recall exact first-turn reconstruction and four distinct ё-folded fallback choices
Three distinct complete Cyrillic speech tokens of at least four letters, present after ё fold and off the explicit denylist/pronoun list
Exactly one pattern example equals a learner turn; every highlight contiguous
Whole-token trophy anchoring in first reply and trophy example; all allocations match the spec
Seven genderAlternatives objects on P1 L4–10, key '1' only; no P2 alternatives
Target script/characters; exact opening in both captions; no complete complication or four-token complication leak
mechanicalChecks.limitations: These checks establish source mechanics, not complete Russian-language gate correctness or rendered runtime behavior. Context-dependent ё, grammar, gender and staging were separately read semantically.

languageAudit.register: Formal вы throughout both paths; no ты/slang or bureaucratic calque found in spoken turns. German dialogue bases maintain the corresponding formal address.

gender.p1Canonical: female where the singular speaker agrees; otherwise gender-free/plural/third-person
gender.p2Canonical: all learner turns gender-free despite the even-path male roster plan

languageAudit.staging: P1 L1–3 maintain imperfective background, L4–6 completed events against background, L7–10 когда/пока/time sequencing. P2 progresses from impersonal opinion to concession and then however/on-the-other-hand framing. A2-inherited future/comparatives/можно/потому что remain licensed. Recognition-only interlocutor forms are not mistaken for early learner production.
languageAudit.clozeChoiceReview: All 40 blanks use the permitted form menu and meaningful subject/tense/aspect or impersonal/comparative cues. Choices are real Russian forms; canonical selection is unique under the displayed cue and sentence. A third optional blank or a connector in every lesson is not required.
languageAudit.recallChoiceReview: All 20 canonical recall answers are content words, not gender-agreeing speaker forms. Fallbacks are source-recall alternatives, not new free-completion accepted answers. No ё/е pair collides within one four-choice set. Current TypeRecallStep reveals the canonical answer rather than displaying these fallback choices.
languageAudit.chipReview: All 20 chip sets and both distractors were read for meaning as visible with the first-turn base cue. Distractors change the intended meaning. The P2 L4 same-meaning alternate order is retained as RU-B1-PUB-03; no source rewrite was performed.
languageAudit.orthography: Canonical target text is Cyrillic with written ё in the reviewed forms; numerals are written as words. Standard full ё→е acceptance folds are content-safe only as explicit accepted variants, never canonical spelling replacement.
languageAudit.baseReview: German and English bases were personally read. One timing nuance is retained as RU-B1-PUB-04; it does not change Russian canonical audio text.
